title: Map the Customer Buying Process
not_for: The venture's marketing activities or CRM stage names.
input_gate: Ground timing in actual comparable purchases when possible; distinguish observed timing from forecast assumptions.

buying_stages.entry_condition: Draft invoice matches a recent approved invoice

obstacles.mitigation: Validate one sample file before quoting the pilot

example_note: A signed agreement, payment, and implementation readiness can occur at different times; represent each material delay.
failure_case: Missing customer-side owners, exit evidence, or negative elapsed times fail validation.
